title: Multi-Kunai Throw
body:
Syntax: multi-kunai throw <target>

Description: Throws three carried kunai in one attack. Spent kunai land on the room floor. Requires a carried kunai. Base damage: 24-29. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 20. Costs 0 Chakra and 16 Stamina; 4.5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
